evals.prompt: Get the UniProt domain architecture and AlphaFold-derived structural RSA for human hemoglobin beta (P68871).
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report for P68871 with its Globin feature, AlphaFold model provenance, and a numeric structural RSA value when the model is available.

evals.prompt: Read a two-column TSV of P00533, P68871, and P04637, then generate one combined domain report without RSA calculations.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report with three resolved UniProt entries and feature tables, demonstrating first-column batch parsing and the --no-rsa path.

evals.prompt: Look up a UniProt entry name (HBB_HUMAN) and return its FASTA sequence.
evals.expected_output: A valid FASTA record whose header and sequence correspond to the HBB_HUMAN UniProt entry.
